name: RC-B10-0087/2025 – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the case of Boualem Sansal in Algeria
part_text:
The European Parliament is calling for the release of Boualem Sansal, a French-Algerian writer arrested in Algeria in November 2024. It says he was held without access to his family or a lawyer. The Parliament also asks for the release of other activists, journalists and prisoners held for speaking out. It urges the European Union to raise these concerns with Algeria and to send a medical team to check on Sansal's health. This is an opinion, not a change in law.

- The Parliament demands Sansal's release and a medical check on his health.
- It affects Sansal, other prisoners of opinion, and Algeria's government.
- The text goes to Algeria, the European Commission and the EU foreign policy chief.
